capabilities.name: Local capability index
capabilities.description: Indexes declarations in a bounded process-local registry.

capabilities.name: Policy-filtered candidate matching
capabilities.description: Matches bounded requirement sets against a bounded process-local index, using immutable declaration snapshots and a fail-closed callback that must return explicit boolean True.
limitations: Matching is advisory, not authorization or proof of capability.
The policy callback is an integration seam; no production policy service or authenticated principal context is connected.
Requirement count is bounded locally; no network API or distributed matching is implemented.

explicit_non_capabilities: distributed registry or network discovery API
agent execution, scheduling or health verification
